name: camphor (synthetic) + phenol
uses: Uses for temporary relief of pain and itching associated with minor burns sunburn minor cuts scrapes insect bites minor skin irritation first aid to help protect against infection in minor cuts scrapes burns
otcwarn: Do not use over large areas of the body with a bandage Ask a doctor before use if you have a deep or puncture wound animal bites serious burns Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days
